marble.prompt: A photorealistic 360-degree view from eye level on top of a gentle grassy hill in soft morning light. Rolling green meadows slope away in every direction under a clear pale sky with a few thin clouds. A flock of white sheep grazes in the middle distance on one side of the hill. On another side stands a small stone shepherd's hut with a chimney. On a third side a lone old oak tree stands on the slope. On the fourth side the hill falls toward a calm lake with snowy mountains far beyond.

projection.notes: yaw_deg rotates which pano direction becomes the front wall. Pick it from seams.jpg so wall boundaries do not cut sheep.

pano.notes: Single-stream design (2026-11-14): tools/pano_reference.py rotates the Marble pano so projection.yaw_deg is the image centre (seam behind the viewer), softens the poles and squashes it to reference.png 1664x960 for Orbis Dynamic. The web sphere maps the full frame back to 360x180. Opening prompt written from reference.png: describe only what is in it, camera wording only here, never name a camera/tripod in steering prompts.
pano.opening: A fixed equirectangular 360-degree panorama time-lapse from the top of a grassy hill: the full surrounding view unwrapped into one wide image, everything stays exactly where it is and only light, haze and grass change. From left to right: a calm lake below snowy mountains, the hill crest with tiny white sheep just right of centre, a small dark hut and a lone oak tree further right, then the lake again. A pale sun glows above the centre. Soft hazy morning light, muted greens.

variants.equirect: An equirectangular 360-degree panorama: the whole view around the top of a grassy hill unwrapped into one wide image, with the horizon curving gently across it. From left to right: a calm lake below snowy mountains, the hill crest with a few small white sheep just right of centre, a small dark hut and a lone oak tree further right, then the lake again. A pale sun glows above the centre. The sheep graze in place, the grass ripples and thin haze drifts. Soft hazy morning light, muted greens.
variants.opening_v1: Static wide panoramic view at eye level from the top of a grassy hill under a pale hazy sky. From left to right: a calm lake below green mountains with snowy peaks, the gentle hill crest with a few white sheep grazing just right of centre, a small dark hut and a large lone oak tree further right, then the lake again. A pale sun glows above the centre. The sheep graze in place, the grass ripples in the breeze and thin haze drifts slowly. Soft hazy morning light, muted greens.

pano.variants_notes: Prompt experiments for keeping the equirect layout (2026-11-14, Dynamic, 40 s each, frames in ~/Assets/.../tests/pano-*): the 'fixed equirectangular 360-degree panorama time-lapse ... everything stays exactly where it is' wording (now 'opening') kept every landmark in place for 30 s; 'equirect' pulled sheep into the foreground; 'opening_v1' held in one headless run but pushed in within ~20 s in the browser run. Select with tools/orbis_test.py --prompt <name>.
pano.events_notes: mode 'steer' = set_prompt on the running session (fine for light changes; 'Evening' as a steer re-composed the panorama within 13 s, 2026-11-14). mode 'reanchor' = reset + set_image(reference) + set_prompt + start on the same session, hidden by a freeze-frame transition; also pulls the layout back after drift. References live in ~/Assets/LivingRoom/scenes/<scene>/ (events/*.png made by editing reference.png, then tools/pano_reference.py --event).

fallback.notes: Used only while Orbis Dynamic is busy (2026-11-14 test: locked camera, layout held 60 s, but wandering animals and the bottom edge degrade after ~50 s -> periodic re-anchor). Personal account, $0.42/min; sessions capped at 10 min by the dev server.

loop.notes: Relay between the keeper's two Dynamic sessions (needs `keeper.py start --sessions 2`): each run is on the sphere ~live_seconds, the other session is anchored and started warmup_seconds before the hand-over, then a fade_seconds live-to-live cross-fade. Without a two-session hold this block is ignored.

pano.frame: A fixed equirectangular 360-degree panorama from the top of a grassy hill: the full surrounding view unwrapped into one wide image.
pano.layout: From left to right: a calm lake below snowy mountains, the hill crest with tiny white sheep just right of centre, a small dark hut and a lone oak tree further right, then the lake again.
pano.fixed_sentence: The land, the hut and the tree stay exactly where they are.
pano.custom_notes: Custom prompts (web/vite.config.js /api/edit): prompt = frame + layout + fixed_sentence + the director's motion and ambience sentences. `fixed` is what the director may never put in motion; the image model is told to keep the same things in place.
